# package sunspec

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-otfp/protocols/sunspec"
```

Package sunspec fingerprints SunSpec Modbus devices: inverters, meters, batteries and other DER that publish the SunSpec information model over Modbus TCP.

Detection reads two holding registers at the SunSpec base addresses 40000, 0 and 50000 (and their off-by-one variants) looking for the "SunS" marker (0x5375 0x6E53), retrying with input registers for devices that map the model there. SunSpec refines Modbus: it is a read-only probe of application registers, so the engine runs it only when read-only probes are allowed, and after a Modbus match.

In identify mode the common model (model 1: manufacturer, model, options, version, serial number, device address) is read, and the model chain is walked to list the models the device implements.
